## Tidy Tuesday Project

- Run by the [Data Science Learning Community](https://dslc.io/)

- Every Tuesday a (mostly) curated dataset is made available with some sample questions 

- The Data Science community is encouraged to work on solutions with code and share with #TidyTuesday hashtag on social media

- [Overview of current and past datasets](https://github.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday#datasets)

- An R package [ttmeta package](https://github.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/blob/main/data/2024/2024-07-02/readme.md) 

- Some Tidy Tuesday Explorations

  - [Mastodon](https://fosstodon.org/tags/tidytuesday), [Bluesky](https://bsky.app/search?q=%23tidytuesday)
  - [Tidy Tuesday screencasts by David Robinson](https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PL19ev-r1GBwkuyiwnxoHTRC8TTqP8OEi8)

## More Data Sources 
### Physical Sciences

- [Global Historical Climatology Network daily (GHCNd)](https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/products/land-based-station/global-historical-climatology-network-daily)

- [USGS Earthquake Information](https://earthquake.usgs.gov/)

- Lake Powell [Releases](https://catalog.data.gov/dataset/lake-powell-glen-canyon-dam-and-powerplant-daily-lake-reservoir-release-total-cfs-time-ser?from_%3D%3D) and [Reservoir Elevation](https://catalog.data.gov/dataset/lake-powell-glen-canyon-dam-and-powerplant-daily-lake-reservoir-elevation-ft-time-series-d?from_%3D%3D)
- Great Salt Lake [Bathymetry: Elevation, Area, and Volume tables](https://catalog.data.gov/dataset/great-salt-lake-elevation-area-volume-tables?from_%3D%3D)

- EnviroAtlas Salt Lake City
  - [1 $\text{km}^2$ resolution data on the proportion of impervious surfaces](https://catalog.data.gov/dataset/enviroatlas-salt-lake-city-ut-impervious-proximity-gradient?from_)
  - Tree cover along [walkable roads](https://catalog.data.gov/dataset/enviroatlas-salt-lake-city-ut-estimated-percent-tree-cover-along-walkable-roads?from_) and [busy roads](https://catalog.data.gov/dataset/enviroatlas-salt-lake-city-ut-estimated-tree-cover-along-busy-roads?from_)
    
- [Meteorite Landings](https://catalog.data.gov/dataset/meteorite-landings?from_hint=eyJzb3J0IjoicG9wdWxhcml0eSIsInEiOiIiLCJzcGF0aWFsX2ZpbHRlciI6Im5vbi1nZW9zcGF0aWFsIn0%3D)



## More Data Sources 
### Social Sciences

  - [CDC and Prevention: Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance System](https://www.cdc.gov/brfss/index.html)
  
  - [General Social Survey (NORC)](https://gss.norc.org/)
  
  - [Supply Chain Greenhouse Gas Emission Factors](https://catalog.data.gov/dataset/supply-chain-greenhouse-gas-emission-factors-v1-3-by-naics-6?from_hint=eyJzb3J0IjoicG9wdWxhcml0eSIsInEiOiIiLCJzcGF0aWFsX2ZpbHRlciI6Im5vbi1nZW9zcGF0aWFsIn0%3D)
  
  - [CDC WONDER: Cancer Statistics](https://catalog.data.gov/dataset/cdc-wonder-cancer-statistics?from_hint=eyJzb3J0IjoicG9wdWxhcml0eSIsInEiOiIiLCJzcGF0aWFsX2ZpbHRlciI6Im5vbi1nZW9zcGF0aWFsIn0%3D)
  
  - [Baby Names from the Social Security Administration](https://catalog.data.gov/dataset/baby-names-from-social-security-card-applications-national-data?from_hint=eyJzb3J0IjoicG9wdWxhcml0eSIsInEiOiJiYWJ5IG5hbWVzIiwic3BhdGlhbF9maWx0ZXIiOiIifQ%3D%3D)
  
```{r} 
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 3
#remotes::install_github("heike/classdata")
library(classdata)
library(ggplot2)
happy |> dplyr::filter(!is.na(happy)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(year), fill = happy)) + 
  geom_bar(position="fill") + xlab("Year") + 
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("grey30", "lightgoldenrod1", "orange"))
```
